title: VDBE rejected result-value destruction and too-big publication

scope.rationale: invokeValueDestructor is the shared API-armor cleanup boundary for rejected blob/text/pointer result inputs: it consumes custom ownership exactly once and publishes SQLITE_TOOBIG when a live function context exists.
excluded_responsibilities: Public sqlite3_result_* API armor entry checks

dependencies.caller_closure: The complete private cleanup body is assigned and integrated into the source-layout 64-bit blob/text result limit paths. Nullable public wrappers remain follow-on work.

inputs: Rejected nullable value pointer, non-dynamic ownership strategy, and optional source-layout Context
outputs: SQLITE_TOOBIG after optional custom destruction and optional context error publication
contracts.ownership: Static and transient inputs remain caller-owned. Custom input is destroyed exactly once. SQLITE_DYNAMIC is a documented-invalid input for these callers and remains unreachable.
contracts.state_and_results: A live context receives sqlite3_result_error_toobig; null context performs cleanup only. Return is always SQLITE_TOOBIG.
contracts.locks_callbacks_io: Caller owns the connection mutex when context is live. Custom destructor runs synchronously before error publication. No I/O.
contracts.failure_and_continuation: Cleanup has no allocation dependency except the existing static too-big result message path. The context remains a valid error result and can be finalized normally.

representation_differences: C destructor sentinels are represented by the existing typed StringOwnership union; the source SQLITE_DYNAMIC assertion is an unreachable union branch.
The rejected pointer is a nullable const anyopaque value and is const-cast only for the source-compatible destructor call.

oracle.protocol: A native source-layout unit trace rejects a custom-owned byte with a live Context and compares return, exactly-once destructor count, context isError, and static too-big result text storage. The integrated blob64/text64 paths call the same owner.
oracle.normalization: Rejected pointer address is not compared; ownership count and error state are exact. Pinned-C API-armor trace remains pending.

assurance.oom: The operation itself allocates no owned input; static error-message behavior is retained.
assurance.io_crash_concurrency: No I/O; caller mutex contract remains external.
assurance.malformed_input: Null context and null pointer are valid cleanup inputs; dynamic ownership is source-documented invalid.
assurance.continuation: Live context remains finalized as a normal TOOBIG function result.
assurance.performance: Constant time and at most one destructor callback.

integration.native_call_path: The helper is used by source-layout resultBlob64 and resultText64 over-limit paths; nullable exported result APIs remain pending.
integration.bounded_owner_retired: No. Public bounded result wrappers still own API dispatch.

independent_review.notes: Requires pinned-C API-armor trace, public result integration, assurance closure, and independent review.

known_blockers: Port nullable public sqlite3_result_blob/text/pointer wrappers against source-layout Context.
